security_incident.name: Security Incident Alert
security_incident.subject: Important: Account Security Verification Required
security_incident.body_html:
🔒 Security Alert

Dear User,

⚠️ Unusual Activity Detected

Our security team has detected unusual activity on your account from an unrecognized device.

As part of our routine security measures, we need to verify your account information to ensure your data remains protected.

📍 Detection Details:

  • Unrecognized login attempt
  • Unusual location access
  • Time: Within last 24 hours

Please reply to this email if you would like more information about this security alert or if you did not authorize this activity.

🛡️ Your account security is our top priority

This is an automated security notification. If you believe this was sent in error, please contact support immediately.

Thank you for your cooperation in keeping your account secure.

Best regards,
Security Team

social_media.name: Social Media Verification
social_media.subject: Action Required: Verify Your Profile - Unusual Activity
social_media.body_html:
📱 Profile Verification Required

Hello,

⚠️ We've noticed unusual activity on your profile

Your account has been flagged for potential policy violations and requires immediate verification.

To maintain your account in good standing and prevent suspension, we need you to confirm your identity.

📋 Issues Detected:

  • Multiple login attempts from different locations
  • Unusual posting pattern detected
  • Profile information inconsistencies
  • Potential terms of service violations

Please reply to this email if you need assistance with the verification process or if you believe this was sent in error.

🔐 Protecting your online presence is important to us

This is an automated message from our Trust & Safety team. Do not share this email with others.

Thank you for your cooperation,

Trust & Safety Team

it_upgrade.name: IT System Upgrade
it_upgrade.subject: URGENT: Mandatory System Upgrade - Action Required by [DATE]
it_upgrade.body_html:
⚙️ Mandatory System Upgrade Notice

Dear User,

🔴 CRITICAL: System Maintenance Required

Our IT department is rolling out a mandatory security update to all user accounts. Failure to comply may result in account suspension.

As part of our ongoing commitment to cybersecurity, we are upgrading our systems to the latest security protocols. All users must complete this upgrade within 72 hours.

📋 Upgrade Details:

  • New authentication system implementation
  • Enhanced data encryption protocols
  • Updated password requirements
  • Two-factor authentication setup

⚠️ What You Need to Do:

Reply to this email to receive your personalized upgrade instructions and verification code. The process takes less than 5 minutes.

⏰ Deadline: 72 hours from receipt of this email

🚫 Non-compliance: Account will be temporarily suspended

Please reply to this email to confirm your participation in the upgrade process and receive further instructions.

🔧 Upgrade Now to Maintain Access

This is a mandatory system notification. All users must comply.
IT Support Ticket: #SYS-UPGRADE-2025

Thank you for your cooperation,

IT Systems Department
